nom: Naked Sundays CabanaClear Illuminating Water Gel Serum SPF 50

avis.texte: This has been my go to sunscreen for over a year now. It works really well with my acne prone skin, and under my makeup as long as I add a primer. LOVE!

avis.titre: Nice texture, wished it sunk in more!
avis.texte: I really felt like this sat on top of my skin, rather than being absorbed properly. I felt oily, not glowy, and I'm sick of worrying about getting this around the necks of my clothing. Nice texture, but will be returning.

I love how lightweight this is! Seriously perfect summer staple that has helping protect my skin but also leaves me with a beautiful effortless glow that looks amazing. This is definitely a must in my summer routine and would be perfect for any skin type! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The NAKED SUNDAYS CabanaClear Water Gel Serum is something I haven't seen before- sunscreen that's meant to smooth into your makeup look effortlessly. I applied it on clean skin and it does hide redness like a concealer (albeit it is a little hard to blend due to it being part sunscreen too). I liked how the color blends and the texture is smooth, it also isn't sticky or transfers onto my finger (too much) when touching it. The sunscreen smell is obviously there which I don't mind at all, I also tested it earlier in the day out in the sun and it lasted for hours. I didn't really feel sticky at all. I think maybe with this, it does apply and look a bit splotchy, it doesn't cover up acne (like I have in the photo), but I don't really expect it to as it's not 100% a concealer/foundation- it is meant to be a sunscreen that'll protect your skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Love this new uniquely made naked serums with spf 50. It is perfect for daily use and very easy to incorporate into your skincare routine. the application process is very easy and unique. Love the shade match and it does not dry out my skin. Very glowy on my skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been loving the Naked Sundays Water Gel Serum SPF 50. The lightweight gel texture feels refreshing on the skin and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue or white cast. It layers beautifully under makeup and gives my skin a hydrated, healthy-looking glow throughout the day. I appreciate that it provides high SPF protection while feeling more like a skincare serum than a traditional sunscreen. Perfect for everyday wear! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This sunscreen is a lightweight, completely clear serum that goes on smooth and melts instantly into my skin. Because it doesn't use zinc, there is absolutely zero white cast, so I don't have to worry about looking pale or chalky. It leaves behind a very noticeable, radiant satin glow, which is great for my dry areas or when I want a really hydrated base under my makeup. Plus, since it doesn't have that heavy, slippery silicone feel, my foundation sits on top of it beautifully without balling up or flaking off. However, that intense dewiness is a double-edged sword. On oily days, it can easily cross the line into feeling greasy and sticky rather than fresh. I used primer under to help decrease the shine. I also love the packaging! Ultimately, if you want an invisible, glowy primer-moisturizer hybrid and don't mind spending a bit more, it works wonders, but I'd pass on it if you have oilier skin and/or prefer a matte finish. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is my first time using a sunscreen quite like this. It is a tan color, but almost instantly disappears when I spread it. It spreads very easily and the radiance lets me know if I missed any spots. It feels very lightweight and helps hydrate my dry skin.This is perfect for having an illuminating glow while protecting your skin from sun damage. I don't wear makeup, but love to have an illuminated, healthy glow to my skin.I love a sunscreen that is also skincare and the added glow this gives makes it my new favorite.I received this as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Miami sun approved! I stood in line for a Naked Sunday event where I first tried them so I was so excited to try the full size product because at 50spf I mean that's a win in itself! The fact that this has no smell, easy to blend in, not greasy, and works makes this one I'll go back for again and again! I used for a long day at the pool and was pleased at the protection it gave me! When I applied it the product goes in like butter on my skin! With the clear formula I'm able to blend in seamlessly and not have to worry about a white residue trying to rub it in. The formula has no smell which is also a win because some products can get pretty strong! Overall this product is one of the best I've tried for my face spf and one that is staying in rotation! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've tried a lot of SPF products, but this one is a standout. The texture is lightweight, non-sticky, and absorbs beautifully. My skin looks hydrated, healthy, and naturally glowy. I love SPF 50, so I can wear just this and feel protected and polished all day! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the NAKED SUNDAYS CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating for a week now, and I can honestly say it's one of the nicest SPF products I've tried. Sunscreen is usually the step I dread most in my routine because so many formulas feel greasy, heavy, or leave a white cast, but this one completely surprised me. The texture is incredibly lightweight and truly feels like a water gel serum. It absorbs quickly into the skin and layers beautifully under makeup without pilling.The illuminating finish gives such a healthy glow without looking oily or overly shiny. It makes my skin look fresh and hydrated, especially on days when my complexion feels dull or dry. I also appreciate that it doesn't feel sticky throughout the day, even in warm weather. It gives that "glowy skin" look while still feeling breathable and comfortable.One of the biggest positives for me is that it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes, which is something I struggle with when trying new SPF products. I have combination/sensitive skin, and this formula worked really well for me without causing breakouts or congestion. It also sits nicely over skincare and under foundation, making it easy to wear every single day.Overall, this is an SPF that actually makes me want to apply sunscreen consistently. The combination of high SPF protection, lightweight texture, and radiant finish makes it stand out from many others I've tried. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a glowy, comfortable

I'm pretty picky when it comes to sunscreen because most of them either feel greasy, leave a white cast, or make my makeup look weird by lunchtime. The CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF 50 in Illuminating was a pleasant surprise. The texture is super lightweight and sinks into my skin almost instantly, so it doesn't feel like I'm wearing sunscreen at all. What really sold me was the glow it gives. It's not glittery or overly shiny, just that healthy "I actually got enough sleep and drank my water" kind of glow. I've been wearing it on no-makeup days and under makeup, and it works beautifully both ways. My skin feels hydrated, protected, and looks more radiant without feeling heavy or sticky. It's one of those products that makes wearing sunscreen every day feel less like a chore and more like a skincare step you actually look forward to. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I recently received the Naked Sundays cabana clear water gel serum spf 50 illumating recently as part of an educational program. I really like this product. I work outside a couple days a week and when it's hot and I'm sweating I don't want to wear a lot of make up. The illuminating spf water gel is perfect for those days, it protects my skin from the sun while giving me a more even and radiant complexion. It also goes well under makeup and smooth over my spf moisturizer with no piling. I would highly recommend this product. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I loved how beautiful this serum SPF is. The package is luxurious, the dispenser works very well, giving just the right amount without waste. The texture is very lightweight, it doesn't make my skin oily, just naturally glowy and revived. It didn't make my skin look yellow, and it also doesn't have any scent. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

[This item was received free as a part of an educational promotion]The nitty gritty is that this product delivers a great glow that is great for POC as it leaves no trace of white cast. This conclusion is based on the following:1. Texture: This is indeed a weightless serum applies evenly to the skin. The glow is truly luminescent without a hint of shimmer or glitter. It's worth noting that the consistency is not akin to a gel as one might expect from the name, but this isn't problematic to me because...2. Layering: This serum SPF provides a great base for makeup. It doesn't pill or separate underneath makeup. Also, the glow peeks through with a light to medium coverage foundation.3. Quantity: I was surprised by how long this seemingly small bottle lasts. And let me be clear: I don't skimp when I pump. I have been dispensing at least a handful of pumps every morning and yet, it just keeps going, and going and going. In this economy, few things render me as excited as a cosmetics/personal product that delivers your money's worth. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is my new favorite sunblock. This glides on your skin, with a timy tint, more of an illumination glow. There is no drying out your skin, or white casting. I am in love with the glow this water gel gives you, not to mention the sun protection I received. I wear this everyday, and leave behind the foundation, and it really illuminates your skin *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Naked Sundays CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating fits really easily into my morning routine. I use it as my last skincare step before applying my makeup, and I liked that it felt more like a light gel serum than a typical sunscreen. It spreads smoothly, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a white cast that some SPF products do. The illuminating finish is also pretty, and glowy without looking greasy. I also like that it doesn't pill under my makeup, and my skin feels hydrated and comfortable. It's great for daily sun protection, while providing fresher and brighter looking skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This Naked Sundays cabana clear water gel serum with SPF 50 has a lightweight texture and it absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving any greasy feeling. It is a great product for everyday use as a part of my skincare routine. It works well under make up without pilling. This cabana clear water gel serum gives illuminating radiant finish glow which is nice and it doesn't leave white cast. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The first thing I noticed is how lightweight it feels. The texture is more like a watery gel serum than a regular sunscreen, and it spreads really easily across the skin without that thick sunscreen feeling. It absorbs fast too, which made it easy to wear under makeup without everything sliding around later.I've been using it every morning as the last step in my skincare routine and it layers nicely with moisturizer without pilling. Once it dries down, it feels almost like nothing is on my skin. There's no heavy or sticky finish, and I like that it doesn't leave a white cast at all. My skin leans combination and some SPF products make me look overly shiny, but this one gives more of a natural finish instead of greasy.What I like most is that it feels comfortable enough to actually reapply during the day. A lot of sunscreens technically work fine but feel unpleasant after a few hours, and this one stays lightweight even when the weather is hot. My skin still feels hydrated while wearing it, but not oily or suffocated. I haven't had any breakouts or irritation from it either, which is always something I pay attention to with facial SPF. Overall it's been really easy to use daily because it feels more like skincare than a traditional sunscreen. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Naked Sunday's CabanaClear Water Gel n Serum with spf 50 is the sunscreen to wear when you want to be both protected and noticed. It has an illuminating factor and adds a light tint and shimmer to your skin on top of protecting you from the sun's harmful rays. I have used it on any exposed skin including my face, decollete, and arms. You can wear it under makeup or on its own. It is easy to dispense and apply the product. The bottle is not too big nor too small but a small enough size that it is easy to carry in most bags. I recommend this product for those that want to add shimmer with their sun protection. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: My skin is obsessed with this sunscreen
avis.texte: My skin absolutely loves this sunscreen. I have super oily, acne prone skin and thankfully this didn't make me break out or feel greasy at all. It gives my skin such a healthy glowy look instead of that heavy oily feeling. It also sits really well under makeup and doesn't pill or separate throughout the day. Definitely one of the few sunscreens my skin actually enjoys wearing *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Easy application and lots of glow!
avis.texte: It was very easy to use this gel because of the pump applicator, and the gel itself is very lightweight. Since it's a bit of a sunscreen/makeup combination, I did find that it took a while to fully rub in and blend into the skin without any streakiness. The glow is nice and has a bit of shimmer to it, but I wouldn't necessarily recommend it for a subtle look since you need to use more product to apply an adequate amount of sunscreen. I enjoyed it overall and will probably be using it more as a glowy primer than a standalone sunscreen! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 on my face and neck for about a week now and I'm genuinely impressed. I live in Pennsylvania where the weather can get humid, and this SPF still feels incredibly lightweight and breathable on the skin. It absorbs quickly, doesn't feel greasy or sticky, and truly gives that subtle "lit-from-within" glow without looking shiny or overdone.I spend time outdoors in the sun regularly and also work around screens/blue light throughout the day, so daily SPF is really important to me. I also pair it with sunglasses and hats for extra protection, and this serum layers beautifully into my routine. No white cast, no pilling, and it sits nicely under makeup while still looking natural on bare skin.My skin can be sensitive at times, so I appreciate the calming ingredients like Centella Asiatica and the added hydration from Hyaluronic Acid. It feels more like skincare than sunscreen, which makes me actually want to wear it every day. So far I haven't experienced breakouts or irritation either. Definitely a great option if you want SPF protection with hydration and a healthy glow all in one product. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm fascinated with this Cabana Clear Illuminating Water Gel Serum from Naked Sundays. It's a light weight water gel serum with SPF 50. I love how soothing and hydrating my skin feels when I use it. The color blends in nicely and leaves my skin glowing. It's invisible and doesn't leave a white cast. It even blurs my blemishes and pores. This serum is also water based and non comedogenic. It's for all skin types, fragrance free, vegan and cruelty free. I totally recommend trying it. I received this serum as a part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I loved this product. It made my skin look like it said, illuminated, I loved the glow it provided. I really liked to use this product alone without makeup, but I haven't had any issues with applying it under makeup. It's a really good product and feels nice on the skin. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely love the CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating from Naked Sundays! As someone living in the hot, sunny Florida weather, SPF 50 is a must for truly protecting and maintaining a healthy skin barrier, and this sunscreen has quickly become one of my favorites.The formula is incredibly lightweight with a watery gel consistency that feels so refreshing on the skin. It blends effortlessly and absorbs beautifully without leaving behind any heavy, greasy, or sticky feeling. I also appreciate how hydrating it feels while still sitting comfortably under makeup, making it perfect for everyday wear. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Extremely impressed with this SPF serum! Not only does it have the benefits of SPF (a high factor too!), it has the effect of highlighter on your face as well and gives your skin a hydrated glow! The serum is pretty lightweight and you don't feel it on your face at all throughout the day. The serum also doesn't have much of a scent either. I love how it "illuminates" my features and it looks like I applied highlighter on my cheeks and nose while adding a bright glow! Overall, an amazing product with multiple benefits in one! Product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been trying out this Naked Sundays CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF 50 for a week now, and I really like how it performs on my skin. The gel-serum texture is incredibly lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue or heaviness behind. My favorite feature is the slightly dewy finish, which gives my skin a healthy, natural glow without looking overly oily. It also layers beautifully under makeup—it doesn't pill or cause my foundation to slide throughout the day. In addition, the formula provides a light moisturizing effect, making it very comfortable for daily wear. The SPF 50 protection feels reliable for everyday activities, and my skin never feels congested or uncomfortable after application. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been loving this SPF so far! The texture feels super lightweight and hydrating on the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. It gives such a beautiful healthy glow and layers really nicely under makeup. I also love that it doesn't leave a white cast and makes my skin look fresh and radiant throughout the day. The SPF brush is such a cute bonus and perfect for reapplying on the go *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this as part of an educational promotion.My favorite thing about this product was how comfortable it was. It was light on my skin and hydrating. After a few uses, my skin continues to feel moisturized. Cabana Clear wore well underneath makeup. The products I used blended nicely on top of it and did not pill. If the product's illumination is the main desired effect, then wearing less makeup or a finishing product with an illumination be recommended. I noticed the product naturally lost its dewiness underneath powders and heavy creams. Overall, the product serves best as sunscreen that can be worn underneath makeup and is comfortable or by itself when it can really shine. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love how this SPF goes on my skin; it's very smooth, and can be worn as a primer because it doesn't pill under makeup. The pump is fantastic, very easy to control the amount needed. I have dry skin, and my skin is light, which gives me a subtle glow and slight hydration, very sheer. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

"Product was reviewed as part of an educational promotion" This product is amazing! I have a history of breaking out from SPF but this one did not cause any problems for me. It made my skin extremely glowy and it did not burn my eyes like other SPF products have done in the past. The texture is very lightweight, which allows it to feel like nothing is on your face once it settles in. As a person of color, sometime SPF may leave a white cast but this one did not do that at all. The size of the product is great for travel. I love this product and I couldn't recommend it more! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Yassss! I will 100% be grabbing this all summer long before I head outside into the sun! This left my skin so glowy and nice and was extremely hydrating. I love that there was a very light sunscreen scent. Easy to layer if you want to use foundation on top but seriously looks so dewy and pretty on the skin without anything else! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product was amazing! It left my skin feeling hydrated and glowy without looking or feeling heavy or greasy! The color made for a seamless blend into the skin with absolutely zero white cast! The bottle design is super pleasing to look at and is easy to take for on the go use! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have enjoyed my experience using the Cabana Clear Serum. I have combination skin that leans very oily this time of the year, and was nervous this would make me greasy, but it didn't at all! The serum gave me a nice glow, and definitely protected me from the very sunny days we've had recently. I think the coverage could be a bit better, but I was still content. If you're looking for something to even out your skin tone, you'll want to layer something over it. The biggest issue for me was that my bottle arrived broken, making it hard to pump out product. I received this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: I actually look forward to this!
avis.texte: This is the first sunscreen I actually look forward to putting on. The texture is incredible, weightless, and absorbs quickly. I have acne prone skin and I was pleasantly surprised that I have zero break outs with this formula! This is a huge win for me this summer. It looks gorgeous under my makeup too. I would love to see a water resistant version in the future so I can wear it while in the pool! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Since it's a serum, it feels hydrating and doesn't dry out my skin, though it is slightly thicker than a typical serum. It comes out with a slight tint at first, but blends seamlessly into the skin once applied. It also absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling oily, while still keeping it hydrated. I like using it on cloudy days or when UV levels are lower, since I personally feel more protected with a standalone sunscreen for stronger sun exposure. Still, this product does everything it claims to do. Naked Sundays is my new favorite brand now! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Naked Sunday Water Gel Serum SPF for the last week since receiving it and it is perfection! I always have the same issues with any SPF. They are hard to blend out and leave a white cast on my face. Not this product at all! At first application it looks like it is tinted but it's a lightweight SPF that blends out and becomes transparent while leaving your skin with a sheer glow while protecting your skin! One of my favorite products I received and I will be switching to this as my go to SPF. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: obsessed with this glowy summer staple
avis.texte: I've been using the CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating for like a week now and I'm actually obsessed. It gives such a nice glowy finish without making me look greasy, and it sits really well under makeup too. My skin is super picky with SPF products but this one didn't break me out at all. Also doesn't have that weird sunscreen smell which I apreciate lol. Definitely repurchasing. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been really impressed with the CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating. The texture feels incredibly lightweight and serum-like, so it sinks into the skin fast without feeling greasy or heavy. It gives such a pretty lit-from-within glow that makes my skin look healthy and radiant without looking glittery.What I love most is how well it layers under makeup. It doesn't pill, leaves no white cast, and gives a smooth hydrated finish that works beautifully as a primer. The formula feels more like skincare than sunscreen, which makes it easy to wear every day.I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free and comfortable on sensitive skin. The only small downside is that if you're very oily or sensitive around the eyes, it may feel a little dewy by the end of the day. But overall, this is one of the most elegant SPF serums I've tried and definitely worth it if you want sun protection with a glowy finish. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

received product part as an educational promotion.This spf is amazing! It goes on so easily and gives the best glow to your face for a day out in the sun. It feels super light and does not make you look oily at all. It is the best everyday sunscreen I have tried yet and will definitely prevent wrinkles. You don't even need a brush to blend it out. This definitely protects me from the sun and I also feel like I can enjoy the day without getting burnt. The formula is so good and even my friends love it. This sunscreen does not show any texture on your skin and is super smooth. The application on the bottle is amazing and so easy to use with just an easy pump. The packaging is so cute too! This product leaves no white cast so it is perfect to rub in without a mirror and it is not too matte and not too oily. This product does not cake or pill on your skin, which is so amazing, especially with sunscreen. This is perfect for sensitive skin and even acne prone. The price is amazing for the amount that you get and you cannot beat this!! This is definitely one of my favorite sunscreens. I love it so much and you should definitely get it. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was so excited to try CabanaClear Water Gel Serum SPF50 in Illuminating. I hate using SPF on my face as it's hard to use . Some different products leave white cast but this doesn't. It's easy to use. The bottle is super lightweight and great to keep around. It's also so eye catching. It's does exactly what it says it will achieve, I would love to see anyone who hates SPF on the same to try this. It does go on gel like and does not leave any trace. No smells. A new must have in my daily routine. I did receive this product in exchange for my honest opinion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this as a part of an educational promotion. However, the Naked Sundays CabanaClear Water Gel Serum with SPF 50 is absolutely amazing! It is a tinted sunscreen with moisturizing components! I love how you can replace your foundation with this sunscreen or even use it under powder, OR you can use it as a base moisturizer! It is so versatile! I absolutely love love love this product! Perfect for the summer coming up too! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this as a part of an educational promotion. CabanaClear SPF 50 is the glow-boosting sunscreen my skin needed! The clear water-gel texture feels weightless, layers perfectly under makeup, and leaves zero white cast or grease. My skin stays hydrated, calm, and radiant all day with the prettiest soft-focus finish. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really loved the Naked Sundays Water Gel Serum SPF 50. The brand claims that the product has an illuminating effect, and it truly does. If you look closely, the formula contains a very fine shimmer that gives the skin the most beautiful glow. I personally love that fresh, radiant skin effect. The texture is incredibly lightweight and truly feels like a water-gel formula. The product glides onto the skin and spreads so easily, which is not always the case with SPF products. Another thing I loved is that it has absolutely no white cast and feels very lightweight on the skin. At first application, it almost seems like the product has a slight tint, but it actually becomes completely transparent once blended into the skin. I wore it both on its own and under makeup, and it performed beautifully in both cases. It felt lightweight, didn't pill under foundation, and gave my skin a radiant finish. I'm honestly very impressed with this SPF. It's the first sunscreen I've tried with such an unusually pleasant texture. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really like this product! When I'm trying sunscreens, the first thing I look for is the thinness/thickness. I prefer my sunscreen to be lightweight and thats exactly how this one is! I love that it has a sheer glow too because it looks really pretty under makeup and makes my skin look glowy and healthy.received as a part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I always love to try new products and new brands. I have must few products from naked sundays but this water gel serum illuminating is at different level. It has spf 50 which helps you to protect in sun, along with that it has illuminating serum which gives you perfect dewy no makeup look. If you are some one like me who don't like to apply foundation on daily basis but still needs some dewy effect along with spf this product is for you. I am using this product from a week and got multiple compliments for this product. It smootly blends in skin without leaving any cast at all. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this product. It has the consistency of a tinted moisturizer but with the added bonus of SPF 50. It really does illuminate and made my skin glowy. A little goes a long way. I layered it over my toner and moisturizer. It did not make me break out. It has a slight fragrance of a typical sunscreen (sort of tropical) - so if that is an issue for you - be aware. I would purchase this. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Lightweight SPF with a glowy finish ✨
avis.texte: I love how lightweight and refreshing this SPF feels on my skin. It blends in easily, gives a beautiful glow without feeling greasy, and layers perfectly under makeup. The SPF brush is also super convenient for quick touch-ups during the day! I recommend *This review was collected as part of a promotion.
